preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call privileged functions

exploit_hint: The vulnerability is about unused variables that create confusion and potential state inconsistencies. The '_default' CustomTaxPeriod struct is defined but never used - all fee modifications happen to '_base' instead. As owner, call setAllFeesToZero() to set all base fees to zero, then verify that the unused '_default' struct remains unchanged (still has its initial values). This demonstrates the state inconsistency caused by the unused variable pattern.
